integrity: The claimed minimum is only over finite fields and only for linear \([6,3]\)-\(\mathrm{MDS}(3)\) codes in the cited higher-order MDS sense. The exact arithmetic and exhaustive projective enumeration are reproducible from the included verifier.
scientific_limitations: The finite classification uses the published equivalence between the \([n,3]\)-\(\mathrm{MDS}(3)\) condition and the projective no-three-collinear plus nonconcurrent-disjoint-secants criterion. The verifier exhausts all normalized six-point configurations over every finite field of order below \(11\), but it does not independently rederive that equivalence from the general subspace-intersection definition.
title: Minimum field size \(11\) for \([6,3]\)-\(\mathrm{MDS}(3)\) codes
